introH2: A desert operator, not a booking agency
introLede: We own the machines, employ the guides and run the base. That is unusual in Dubai and it changes what we can do for you.
introBody: Buggy Rents started in 2020 and has taken {guests} guests into the desert since. We operate from Al Awir on the Dubai to Hatta road, with {fleet} vehicles and {guides} guides. The red dunes at Lahbab and the terrain around Al Awir are our routes, and our guides ride them daily.

We are the operator. A lot of desert tour websites in Dubai are booking agencies that pass you to whoever has a machine free. We own the buggies, quads and dirt bikes, we employ the guides, and you pay us at our base. If something goes wrong there is nobody else to point at.

We price per vehicle. This matters more than it sounds. A four seat buggy at AED 350 for 30 minutes is AED 350 for the buggy, so four people pay under AED 90 each. Operators quoting per person look cheaper until you multiply by the group.
We are open 24/7 and hotel pickup anywhere inside Dubai is free. Sunrise and late afternoon are the sessions worth booking, and being open around the clock is what makes an early start possible.

minis.p: {fleet} vehicles, maintained at our own base rather than hired in when someone books.
{guides} guides who ride these dunes daily and set the pace for the slowest rider.
Per vehicle, no deposit, free Dubai pickup, and you pay at the base before you ride.

confirmLede: Everything runs from Al Awir, so a group can split across machines and still ride together.

confirm.p: Eleven machines from the Polaris RZR 1000 to the Can-Am Maverick R, two and four seats, from AED {buggyFrom}.
Six quads from 70cc kids machines to the Yamaha Raptor 700cc, from AED {quadFrom}, with riders from age six.
The KTM 450 desert enduro from AED {dirtbikeFrom}, for riders who already ride off road.
Someone else drives. Dune bashing, camp dinner and a show, for guests who want the desert without controlling a machine.

bentoH2: The things that come up in reviews.
bentoLede: Not what we would put on a poster, but what people actually mention afterwards.

bento.p: The single most common theme in our reviews is the guide. They set the pace for the slowest rider, know which dune faces hold, and will spend the session teaching someone nervous rather than showing off.
The price you were quoted is the price you pay. Free Dubai pickup is genuinely free and there is no deposit to chase.
Kids quads from six, passengers of any age in a four seat buggy. Families rarely have to leave someone sitting out.

bento.h: We move things when we can
bento.p: Weather, late flights, a change of plan. Message us and the first thing we try is a different slot, not a charge.

handledH2: What we handle, and what we ask of you
handledLede: Clear on both sides before anyone gets on a machine.

faqLede: The things people ask before trusting an operator with their group.

faqs.q: How long have you been running?
faqs.a: Since 2020. We have taken {guests} guests into the desert in that time, and we hold a TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice award and a 4.9 rating on Google.
Yes. We own the vehicles, employ the guides and run the base at Al Awir. Many desert tour sites in Dubai are booking agencies that pass you on to whoever has a machine free.
Dubai-Hatta Rd, Al Awir Second, Dubai, UAE. It is on the Dubai to Hatta road, close to the Lahbab red dunes, which is why our routes start where they do.
Open 24/7. In practice sunrise and late afternoon are the sessions worth booking, and being open around the clock is what makes a pre dawn start possible.

faqs.q: How many vehicles do you have?
faqs.a: {fleet} across buggies, quads and dirt bikes, with {guides} guides. Group bookings are usually possible at short notice.

faqs.q: Why are your prices per vehicle?
faqs.a: Because that is what you are hiring. A four seat buggy costs the same to run whether one person or four are in it. Quoting per person looks cheaper on a search results page and costs more when you multiply by the group.
No deposit on standard slots. {payment} Nothing is due when you book, and cancellation is free up to 24 hours before.

faqs.q: Can you handle corporate or large groups?
faqs.a: Yes. Group bookings are quoted separately so we can plan vehicles and guides properly. Send the headcount and date and we will come back with options.
